claim_policy: Only claims listed as passed in the paper claim audit are treated as measured. Open reproduction gates are executable reviewer tasks, not paper results.

measured_claims.boundary: Task--scene proxy shift confounded with task identity; offline action imitation only, not scene-only leakage, ACT/Diffusion, or rollout success.
measured_claims.claim: ArmnetBench random split overlaps task--scene proxy lineages; the task-confounded holdout changes offline imitation metrics.

measured_claims.boundary: Input compatibility only; no trained checkpoint, held-out policy metric, simulator rollout, or physical rollout.
measured_claims.claim: Pinned LeRobot ACT and Diffusion paths decode the materialized source front camera and complete the CUDA smoke optimization step.

measured_claims.boundary: Action/state telemetry-lag proxy on one SO-101 dataset; no independently instrumented motor latency or second robot/controller.
measured_claims.claim: A lag frozen on calibration trajectories improves held-out SO-101 action/state telemetry alignment across multiple tasks.

measured_claims.boundary: One LeRobot trace with minimal MuJoCo and Genesis position-servo adapters; Isaac is not claimed tested; contact physics is evaluated separately.
measured_claims.claim: Timestamp-aware LeRobot replay reduces joint RMSE in tested MuJoCo and Genesis adapters.

measured_claims.boundary: Two scripted primitive tasks with kinematic actors and no hardware ground truth; the observed orientation divergence blocks equivalent-physics claims.
measured_claims.claim: A preregistered two-runtime contact protocol measures trajectory, contact, grasp, pose, and outcome agreement without claiming equivalent physics.

measured_claims.boundary: One complete pinned Parquet shard per dataset; not full corpora or source-video conversion throughput.
measured_claims.claim: Complete pinned source shards from multiple public LeRobotDatasets round-trip exactly through WorldEpisode.

measured_claims.boundary: Task-confounded offline temporal state/action baseline; not a scene-only, vision-policy, ACT, Diffusion, or rollout result.
measured_claims.claim: Temporal state/action baseline changes under the task--scene proxy holdout.

measured_claims.boundary: Pilot projection score, not a universal storage-format ranking.
measured_claims.claim: Pilot bindings inventory native and sidecar retention for a versioned projection.

measured_claims.boundary: Injected and hand-authored fixtures; natural prevalence remains open.
measured_claims.claim: Validator detects all injected fault classes and independent fixture failures.

measured_claims.boundary: Scoped natural-source corpus, not maintainer-confirmed prevalence.
measured_claims.claim: Pilot natural-source audit records scoped cases across public dataset sources.

measured_claims.boundary: Dataset-specific diagnostics, not prevalence or maintainer-confirmed bug evidence.
measured_claims.claim: Natural-source audit distinguishes active artifacts from source-level metadata reviews.

measured_claims.boundary: Deterministic pilots, not production game or AV dataset results.
measured_claims.claim: Deterministic non-robotics USS pilots demonstrate collision-patch and clock-domain drift.

measured_claims.boundary: Controlled proxy; not a hardware or RoboSnap/DROID-Sim rerun.
measured_claims.claim: Controlled real-to-sim contract drift ablations fail under drifted contracts and recover with WorldEpisode.

measured_claims.boundary: Catalog-side evidence only; does not materialize a billion rows or payload bytes.
measured_claims.claim: Generated catalog benchmark describes a large-capacity sharded corpus.

measured_claims.boundary: Source-level call-out audit; no published-score inflation claim.
measured_claims.claim: Famous benchmark audit is fail-closed and makes zero inflation claims in this release.

measured_claims.boundary: Open gates are unclaimed results, not paper results.
measured_claims.claim: Open results are visibly and machine-readably marked as not claimed.

open_results_not_claimed.acceptance_rule: At least one ACT or Diffusion Policy run must report both random_episode and scene_disjoint metrics, and at least one rollout report must use the same split manifest before the stronger policy-impact claim can be made.
open_results_not_claimed.boundary: No ACT, Diffusion Policy, IsaacLab, or hardware success number is claimed until policy metrics and rollout evidence are committed.
open_results_not_claimed.claim: state-of-the-art policy or physical rollout impact
